summary: Show a quiet device re-pairing notice when browser client reads return HTTP 401 or 403.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or data changes.

compatibility.detail: Existing HTTP and WebSocket contracts are unchanged; browser reads classify unauthorized responses before decoding their bodies.

manual.detail: No upgrade actions required. Browsers whose credentials were already expired or revoked must pair the device again to restore access.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or rollback restrictions.
